panels.title: Backend Status
panels.description: Related alert: Backend DOWN. PromQL: up{job="finance-portal-backend"} == 0

panels.title: Average Response Time (ms)
panels.description: Related alert: High Average Response Time. PromQL threshold: average http_server_requests duration > 2 seconds.

panels.title: Response Time by URI (ms)
panels.description: Related alert context: High Average Response Time. Use this panel to identify slow URI groups when the average response time alert fires.

targets.expr: sum by (uri, method, status) (rate(http_server_requests_seconds_count{job="finance-portal-backend"}[5m])) or vector(0)

panels.title: JVM Heap Used
panels.description: Related alert: High JVM Heap Usage. PromQL threshold: heap used / heap max > 0.85.

panels.title: Hikari Pending Connections
panels.description: Related alert: Hikari Pending Connections. PromQL: hikaricp_connections_pending > 0.
